Then mark the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 1 with a single line through the centre.
说明.B: Directions: In this section, you will hear two passages. At the end of each passage, you will hear three or four questions. Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once. 说明.C: Directions: In this section, you will hear three recordings of lectures or talks followed by three or four questions. The recordings will be played only once.
